notes.title: Bedrock High - The Grand Release
notes.content:
Today is the day that Bedrock High, the game I worked on for the past year, has it's release. At this time, I would like to thank everyone who helped make this day possible, including my wife and my son!

I hope everyone who plays the game finds great joy in it! If you don't like it, tell me what you don't like and I will work hard to change your mind.

Special thanks to those out there who give small, family team developers like me a chance in the market. You are the true unsung heroes!

Good luck and have fun
JC
